POLICIES & CUSTOMER CARE

Privacy Policy

How Madikar Taila collects, uses and protects your information when you browse our website, order our products or contact customer support.

Policy effective: September 1, 2026

On this page

Information we collectHow we use your informationPayments and service providersData security and storageRetention and your choicesBrowser storage and cookiesUpdates and privacy enquiries

01Information we collect

We collect information needed to fulfil orders and respond to your enquiries:

  • Identity and contact details: your name, mobile or WhatsApp number and email address.
  • Delivery and billing details: your street address, apartment or door number, landmark, city, state and PIN code.
  • Order and transaction details: products, pack sizes, quantities, order value, payment status and order references.
  • Communications: information you share by WhatsApp, email, website forms, SMS or telephone for support and delivery coordination.
  • Technical information: browser, device and connection information needed to operate and maintain the website.

02How we use your information

We use your information to prepare and dispatch orders, reconcile payments, communicate delivery updates, answer product questions and resolve delivery, replacement or refund requests.

03Payments and service providers

Madikar Taila does not collect or store card credentials, CVV codes, bank passwords or UPI PINs. When online payment is available, payment credentials are handled by the payment provider, such as Razorpay.

We share the recipient’s name, delivery address and phone number with our local delivery team or courier partners to deliver your order. When you choose to send your order and address on WhatsApp, those details are shared through WhatsApp.

We may disclose information when required by applicable Indian law, a judicial order or a lawful request from government authorities. We do not sell, rent or trade your personal information to advertising brokers.

04Data security and storage

We use physical, electronic and administrative safeguards to protect personal information against unauthorised access, loss, misuse or alteration. Connections to madikartaila.com use HTTPS encryption, and access to order records is restricted to authorised personnel.

05Retention and your choices

We retain information for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes described here, including legal, GST, accounting and reporting obligations under Indian law. You may contact us to:

  • Request a review of the personal information we hold about you.
  • Correct or update inaccurate contact or delivery details.
  • Request deletion of non-transactional records, subject to statutory retention requirements.
  • Opt out of non-transactional marketing communications.

06Browser storage and cookies

The storefront uses browser storage to remember your shopping bag. Clearing site data may remove your saved bag. You can manage cookies and site storage through your browser settings; restricting storage may affect shopping features.

07Updates and privacy enquiries

We may update this policy as our practices or applicable requirements change. Updates will be posted on this page with a revised date. For questions about your information, correction or deletion requests, or payment verification, use the customer care details below.
